name: Francesinha Festival at WOW
description: Indulge in Porto's signature sandwich at this weekend-long festival. Sample classic and creative takes on the Francesinha, including vegetarian options, all with stunning views and live music.
longDescription:
The Francesinha Festival at WOW is a dedicated celebration of Porto's iconic sandwich, hosted by the World of Wine cultural district in Gaia. This weekend-long event, scheduled for April 25th and 26th, 2026, focuses on showcasing various interpretations of the Francesinha, from traditional recipes to contemporary and vegetarian adaptations. It serves as an opportunity to explore the culinary versatility of this regional specialty within a dedicated festival format.

Attendees can expect a casual, food-focused atmosphere across the two days. The festival provides an opportunity to sample multiple versions of the Francesinha from different vendors, accompanied by live musical performances. The event takes place at the World of Wine complex, an expansive outdoor and indoor venue situated on the Gaia riverfront, offering views across the Douro River towards Porto. The festival caters to a broad audience interested in local gastronomy.

Entry to the Francesinha Festival is free, with food and drink purchases varying in price. The World of Wine complex is accessible via public transport; it is a walk from General Torres metro station (yellow line) or a short taxi ride from Porto city centre. The venue is generally accessible. The event is suitable for families.
